title: Atalanta's New No.11, United Women’s Historic Signing & SA Cup Showdowns
flags: Rowe arrives from Brighton with a reputation for pace, directness and a knack for cutting inside to create chances.
Rowe will wear the club‑record €40 million transfer fee‑linked No 11 jersey, previously sported by Ademola Lookman before his move to Tottenham.
Serie A matches involving Atalanta have hovered around the 2.5‑goal line this season.
The Mario Alberto Kempes Stadium will host the Argentine Cup clash between Vélez and Boca Juniors.
Both sides have announced their line‑ups, with Boca fielding a blend of experienced heads and emerging talent.
A second‑leg derby between Santos and Palmeiras has been set, with both clubs confirming their line‑ups.
